key_insight: ScaleWorld uses one shared video model to predict low-resolution scenes and refine them into high-resolution video. It sharpens its own predictions rather than relying on a separate refinement model.
problem_solved: Direct high-resolution video generation demands substantial computation and memory, making detailed world-model outputs costly to produce.
method: Use a causal video model to predict low-resolution world video.
Refine those predictions into high-resolution outputs with finer scene structures and textures.
Share a single backbone across prediction and refinement instead of using separate models.
impact: For practitioners building video world models, ScaleWorld offers a unified approach to detailed generation without maintaining a separate refiner. The provided abstract excerpt does not quantify computational savings or output quality.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: low-resolution prediction → shared-backbone refinement → high-resolution video.
Magnified scene crops illustrating coarse structures versus refined textures.
Architecture comparison: separate predictor and refiner versus ScaleWorld’s shared backbone.
Video timeline showing causal prediction followed by refinement.
paper_title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
paper_authors: Yansong Qu, Wesker Zheng, Quanjian Song, Zhiyuan Zhang, Xiao Cao
